title: 网络安全 · 安全评估汇报 30 句
description: 覆盖控制有效性、架构风险、成熟度、合规差距、例外管理与整改路线图的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 本次评估关注控制措施在实际运行中的有效性，而不只是制度是否存在。
items.en: This assessment examines how effectively the controls operate in practice, rather than merely whether policies exist.
answers: This assessment examines how effectively the controls operate in practice, rather than merely whether policies exist.
items.notes: how effectively 与 whether 引导不同的名词性从句；rather than 突出评估重点。

items.zh: 资产清单遗漏了两个由业务部门管理的云账户，因此无法保证覆盖范围完整。
items.en: The asset inventory omitted two cloud accounts managed by business units, so complete coverage could not be assured.
answers: The asset inventory omitted two cloud accounts managed by business units, so complete coverage could not be assured.
items.notes: 过去分词 managed 作后置定语；could not be assured 保持审慎。

items.zh: 尽管流程文件要求季度复核，证据显示过去九个月没有完成过权限审查。
items.en: Although the procedure requires quarterly reviews, the evidence shows that no access review was completed during the previous nine months.
answers: Although the procedure requires quarterly reviews, the evidence shows that no access review was completed during the previous nine months.
items.notes: although 对比制度与执行；被动语态强调审查未完成。

items.zh: 我们抽查的是高权限账户，因此结论不应直接推广到所有普通用户。
items.en: Our sample focused on privileged accounts, and the conclusions should therefore not be generalised to all standard users.
answers: Our sample focused on privileged accounts, and the conclusions should therefore not be generalised to all standard users.
items.notes: therefore not be generalised 限定抽样结论的适用范围。

items.zh: 该控制在设计上合理，但依赖人工操作，且没有机制发现遗漏的步骤。
items.en: The control is sound in design, but it relies on manual action and has no mechanism for detecting omitted steps.
answers: The control is sound in design, but it relies on manual action and has no mechanism for detecting omitted steps.
items.notes: sound in design 评价设计；rely on 与 mechanism for doing 是常用搭配。

items.zh: 风险等级反映当前环境，而不是完成计划中项目后的预期状态。
items.en: The risk rating reflects the current environment, not the anticipated state after planned initiatives have been completed.
answers: The risk rating reflects the current environment, not the anticipated state after planned initiatives have been completed.
items.notes: anticipated state 指预期状态；完成时被动强调未来项目完成后的结果。

items.zh: 由于备份与生产网络使用相同的身份域，勒索软件可能同时影响两者。
items.en: Because backups share the same identity domain as production, ransomware could compromise both environments at once.
answers: Because backups share the same identity domain as production, ransomware could compromise both environments at once.
items.notes: share ... with/as 描述共同依赖；could 表示合理风险而非确定结果。

items.zh: 多因素认证降低了凭据被盗的风险，却无法弥补过度宽泛的管理员权限。
items.en: Multi-factor authentication reduces the risk of credential theft, but it does not compensate for excessively broad administrative privileges.
answers: Multi-factor authentication reduces the risk of credential theft, but it does not compensate for excessively broad administrative privileges.
items.notes: compensate for 表示弥补；but 区分两个控制问题。

items.zh: 如果关键日志只保留七天，调查人员可能无法重建较早发生的入侵。
items.en: If critical logs are retained for only seven days, investigators may be unable to reconstruct an intrusion discovered later.
answers: If critical logs are retained for only seven days, investigators may be unable to reconstruct an intrusion discovered later.
items.notes: if 引出保留期限的后果；discovered later 是过去分词短语。

items.zh: 单个区域故障并不会触发既定恢复方案，因为部分依赖项仍集中部署。
items.en: A single-region failure would not trigger the intended recovery arrangement because several dependencies remain centrally hosted.
answers: A single-region failure would not trigger the intended recovery arrangement because several dependencies remain centrally hosted.
items.notes: would not 描述架构测试情境；remain hosted 表示持续状态。

items.zh: 该架构减少了外部暴露面，但也把内部身份系统变成了单点故障。
items.en: The architecture reduces the external attack surface while making the internal identity service a single point of failure.
answers: The architecture reduces the external attack surface while making the internal identity service a single point of failure.
items.notes: while doing 表示同时产生的相反效果；make A B 是宾补结构。

items.zh: 我们没有把所有未加密流量都评为高风险，而是根据数据敏感度和网络信任边界逐项判断。
items.en: We did not rate all unencrypted traffic as high risk; each case was judged according to data sensitivity and network trust boundaries.
answers: We did not rate all unencrypted traffic as high risk; each case was judged according to data sensitivity and network trust boundaries.
items.notes: rate ... as 与 according to 展示基于语境的判断，分号连接解释。

items.zh: 名义上由第二人审批的变更，实际上可以由提交者使用共享账户批准。
items.en: Changes that nominally require a second approver can in practice be authorised by the submitter through a shared account.
answers: Changes that nominally require a second approver can in practice be authorised by the submitter through a shared account.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句；nominally 与 in practice 揭示控制绕过。

items.zh: 在没有独立监控的情况下，预防性控制失效可能长期不被发现。
items.en: Without independent monitoring, a failure of the preventive control could remain undetected for an extended period.
answers: Without independent monitoring, a failure of the preventive control could remain undetected for an extended period.
items.notes: without 引出缺失条件；remain undetected 表示持续未被发现。

items.zh: 即使供应商通过了认证，组织仍需评估其服务与自身风险场景是否匹配。
items.en: Even where a supplier holds a certification, the organisation must still assess whether its service addresses the organisation's own risk scenarios.
answers: Even where a supplier holds a certification, the organisation must still assess whether its service addresses the organisation's own risk scenarios.
items.notes: even where 表示让步；whether 引导需要评估的内容。

items.zh: 成熟度评分为二级，意味着流程可以重复执行，但结果仍高度依赖个人经验。
items.en: A maturity score of two indicates that the process is repeatable, although outcomes still depend heavily on individual expertise.
answers: A maturity score of two indicates that the process is repeatable, although outcomes still depend heavily on individual expertise.
items.notes: indicate that 解释评分；although 补充成熟度限制。

items.zh: 与上次评估相比，漏洞修复速度有所提高，但逾期例外的数量也增加了。
items.en: Compared with the previous assessment, vulnerability remediation has accelerated, while the number of overdue exceptions has also risen.
answers: Compared with the previous assessment, vulnerability remediation has accelerated, while the number of overdue exceptions has also risen.
items.notes: compared with 引出基准；while 并列一项改善和一项退步。

items.zh: 没有统一指标，我们就无法判断告警减少源于环境更安全还是检测能力下降。
items.en: Without consistent metrics, we cannot determine whether fewer alerts reflect a safer environment or weaker detection capability.
answers: Without consistent metrics, we cannot determine whether fewer alerts reflect a safer environment or weaker detection capability.
items.notes: whether ... or 呈现两种解释；reflect 表示指标反映某种状态。

items.zh: 调查结果表明团队能够处置已知事件，却尚未形成主动发现未知威胁的能力。
items.en: The findings suggest that the team can handle known incidents but has yet to develop the capability to identify unknown threats proactively.
answers: The findings suggest that the team can handle known incidents but has yet to develop the capability to identify unknown threats proactively.
items.notes: has yet to 表示尚未；can ... but ... 区分两种成熟度能力。

items.zh: 若要把成熟度提升到下一级，管理层必须先明确流程负责人和可衡量的结果。
items.en: To reach the next maturity level, management must first define process ownership and measurable outcomes.
answers: To reach the next maturity level, management must first define process ownership and measurable outcomes.
items.notes: to reach 表示目的；process ownership 和 measurable outcomes 是治理术语。

items.zh: 这项做法满足当地保留要求，但不满足合同约定的十二个月期限。
items.en: The practice meets the local retention requirement but falls short of the twelve-month period specified in the contract.
answers: The practice meets the local retention requirement but falls short of the twelve-month period specified in the contract.
items.notes: fall short of 表示未达到要求；specified 作后置定语。

items.zh: 政策例外已经获得批准，不过批准文件没有记录风险接受人或到期日期。
items.en: The policy exception was approved, yet the approval record identifies neither a risk owner nor an expiry date.
answers: The policy exception was approved, yet the approval record identifies neither a risk owner nor an expiry date.
items.notes: neither ... nor 并列两个缺失要素；yet 表示转折。

items.zh: 合规并不自动意味着风险可接受，尤其是在标准没有覆盖新型云服务的情况下。
items.en: Compliance does not automatically make the risk acceptable, particularly where the standard does not address newer cloud services.
answers: Compliance does not automatically make the risk acceptable, particularly where the standard does not address newer cloud services.
items.notes: make A B 是宾补结构；particularly where 限定合规的局限。

items.zh: 我们建议法务部门确认跨境日志传输是否需要额外的合同保障。
items.en: We recommend that the legal team confirm whether cross-border log transfers require additional contractual safeguards.
answers: We recommend that the legal team confirm whether cross-border log transfers require additional contractual safeguards.
items.notes: recommend that 后接动词原形；whether 引导待确认事项。

items.zh: 在监管解释尚未明确之前，应把这一差距记录为待定事项而非确定违规。
items.en: Until the regulatory interpretation is clarified, the gap should be recorded as an open issue rather than a confirmed breach.
answers: Until the regulatory interpretation is clarified, the gap should be recorded as an open issue rather than a confirmed breach.
items.notes: until 引出时间边界；rather than 避免过度下结论。

items.zh: 整改路线图优先处理能够降低多个风险的基础性控制，而不是孤立地关闭单个发现。
items.en: The remediation roadmap prioritises foundational controls that reduce several risks instead of closing individual findings in isolation.
answers: The remediation roadmap prioritises foundational controls that reduce several risks instead of closing individual findings in isolation.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句；in isolation 表示孤立处理。

items.zh: 只有在责任人、预算和完成日期都明确后，这项行动才应被视为已有计划。
items.en: An action should be considered planned only when an owner, budget, and completion date have all been defined.
answers: An action should be considered planned only when an owner, budget, and completion date have all been defined.
items.notes: only when 限定构成有效计划的条件；现在完成时强调已落实。

items.zh: 董事会需要了解剩余风险可能如何影响业务目标，而不仅是未关闭问题的数量。
items.en: The board needs to understand how residual risk could affect business objectives, not merely the number of open findings.
answers: The board needs to understand how residual risk could affect business objectives, not merely the number of open findings.
items.notes: how 引导宾语从句；not merely 区分业务影响和数量指标。

items.zh: 接受风险并不会免除持续监控义务，特别是相关暴露面正在变化时。
items.en: Accepting the risk does not remove the obligation to monitor it, especially while the associated exposure is changing.
answers: Accepting the risk does not remove the obligation to monitor it, especially while the associated exposure is changing.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；obligation to do 表示持续义务。

items.zh: 后续评估将验证控制是否持续运行，而不只是整改当天是否通过测试。
items.en: The follow-up assessment will verify whether the control continues to operate, rather than whether it passed a test on the remediation date.
answers: The follow-up assessment will verify whether the control continues to operate, rather than whether it passed a test on the remediation date.
items.notes: 两个 whether 从句形成评估口径对照；continue to operate 强调持续性。
